gloss: business rival; trade competitor; commercial rival

definitions.gloss: business rival; trade competitor; commercial rival
definitions.explanation: A person or business that competes directly in the same trade or market. Carries a sense of personal rivalry, not just impersonal market competition.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧うち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{商売仇|しょうばいがたき}だ。
examples.english: That shop is our business rival.

examples.japanese: {商売仇|しょうばいがたき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{動向|どうこう}→動向：05580_doukou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{常|つね}→常：28958_tsune⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I always keep an eye on the activities of our business rivals.

examples.japanese: {商売仇|しょうばいがたき}だった⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{協力|きょうりょく}して→協力する：25370_kyouryokusuru⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{事業|じぎょう}→事業：11421_jigyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: The two, who had been business rivals, joined forces to start a new venture.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{商売|しょうばい}→商売：03239_shoubai⟧ (business, trade) and {仇|がたき} (rival, enemy). The word has a personal, somewhat old-fashioned flavor — it implies not just competition but a sense of rivalry between specific people or shops in the same trade.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {商売仇|しょうばいがたき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become business rivals
- {商売仇|しょうばいがたき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{意識|いしき}する→意識する：17974_ishikisuru⟧: to be conscious of one's business rival
- {商売仇|しょうばいがたき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧: a rival shop
- {商売仇|しょうばいがたき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{負|ま}けない→負ける：01134_makeru⟧: to not lose to one's business rival

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{競合|きょうごう}→競合：05082_kyougou⟧: competitor, competing — a modern, neutral business term for market competition; {商売仇|しょうばいがたき} is more personal and vivid
- ⟦ライバル→ライバル：11197_raibaru⟧: rival — the English loanword, used broadly in sports, business, and personal contexts
- {競争相手|きょうそうあいて}: competitor — a neutral term for any competitor; lacks the personal edge of {商売仇|しょうばいがたき}

REGISTER:
Somewhat old-fashioned and literary. Evokes the image of traditional shopkeepers or small business owners competing on the same street. In modern corporate contexts, ⟦{競合|きょうごう}→競合：05082_kyougou⟧ or {競争相手|きょうそうあいて} is more common.
